snippet.title: Find a way to escape the Caves of Candidus!
snippet.description:
Magnus is finally old enough to go into Candidus Caves unfortunately the lift breaks and they need 3 Reparare Rhodonite to fix it!

Credits to

Hudson Glover
Tracks used

Daivuk - Outdoors
Jasontomlee - Effects
Connor Covert (not online) - Gem Animations

This game can be found by going to itch.io and searching for the Author (Omniclause) or the game (Candidus Caves)
